description: List path, SHA-256 and size of every file in the site's editable source tree (the stored pre-build code, not the served files). Read-only. A site without a source tree returns SOURCE_NOT_STORED: write the source with write_source_files, or copy plain static served files with promote_dist_to_source.

autoPromote.description: Deprecated and ignored. Use promote_dist_to_source with mode 'auto'.

forcePromote.description: Deprecated and ignored. Use promote_dist_to_source with mode 'force'.

name.description: Site name as shown by list_sites, e.g. my-portfolio. Provide name or siteId.

siteId.description: Site id from list_sites or get_site. Use instead of name.

name: list_source_files

hint.description: Set when the deprecated autoPromote or forcePromote flag was passed.

title: List the editable source tree for a site
